findings.title: README says `-` is accepted only by `add`, but move/copy also accept it
findings.why: In src/index.ts, `copy` and `move` call addAt with the target path, and addAt handles `-` by appending (line 136). So a `move` or `copy` whose `path` is `/arr/-` succeeds, which is RFC-correct but contradicts the README sentence.

findings.title: Plan refers to a src/pointer.ts module that does not exist
findings.why: The plan and tasks.md (T003) say the pointer code lives in `src/pointer.ts` and is re-exported from `src/index.ts`. The diff adds only `src/index.ts`, which holds all of the code.
